About Shafaf Marriage Bureau

About Shafaf Marriage Bureau

Led by Mian Sajid — Founder with 18 Years of Matrimonial Guidance
"نکاح ایک مقدس سنتِ نبوی ﷺ اور دو خاندانوں کے درمیان باہمی عزت، سچائی اور پاکیزگی کا بندھن ہے۔"

Headquartered in Abbasi Town, Rahim Yar Khan, Punjab, Pakistan, Shafaf Marriage Bureau has provided personalized, strictly confidential, and family-centered Muslim matrimonial services for over 18 years. Under the personal care of founder Mian Sajid, we help families find compatible rishtas based on mutual faith, respect, and honorable background verification across all districts of Punjab, throughout Pakistan, and for Pakistani expatriates overseas.

100% Discretion & Privacy

No public directories or online photo exposures. Candidate details are held as an Amanah and shared only with consent.

Rigorous Background Verification

Founder Mian Sajid personally verifies candidate credentials, educational background, and family references.

Elder & Family Involvement

We follow Islamic matrimonial traditions with respectful parent-to-parent introductions, ensuring lasting harmony.

Punjab & Overseas Network

Serving Rahim Yar Khan, Lahore, Multan, Faisalabad, Rawalpindi, and overseas Pakistani families across the UK, USA, Gulf, and Europe.
